name: ulanzi-deck-skills
description: Configure Ulanzi stream controllers (D200H and family) from your AI agent: build whole Ulanzi Studio profiles with app launchers, hotkeys, media and OBS keys, pages and folders, generated key art and a preview, then apply them with automatic backups and rollback. Windows and macOS, with Linux guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Design and apply Ulanzi stream controller profiles
interface.longDescription: Builds whole Ulanzi Studio profiles for Ulanzi stream controllers (D200H and family) from a small portable layout file: app launchers resolved by name on each OS, websites, hotkeys, media keys, OBS live/record keys, pages and folders. Renders consistent key art and a preview image, applies the profile with an automatic backup and verification, exports existing profiles for editing, and restores backups.
defaultPrompt: Set up my Ulanzi D200H with a coding page and a streaming page
Add OBS live and record buttons to my Ulanzi deck and show me a preview
Export my current Ulanzi profile so I can edit it
